title: Sperm whales sleep standing straight up
text:
Sperm whales sleep standing straight up, like the ocean's tallest exclamation marks.

Researchers tracking pods found the whales drift motionless in vertical columns near the surface for up to 15 minutes at a time, occasionally releasing a slow trail of bubbles that scientists think helps them stay in that restful, near-paralyzed state. It's one of the shortest known sleep patterns of any mammal on Earth.

A creature the size of a school bus, just floating there, dead asleep.
